title: semlayer validate --json issue
description: One entry of the issues list semlayer validate --json prints.

level.description: An error fails validation (exit 1); a warning does not.

file.description: The file, from the semantic root, or the path the issue is about.

path.description: The place in the file (version, measures[0].expr), or empty for the whole file.

message.description: The issue in words, as the human lines print it. Its words may change between releases.

code.description: Stable across releases, registered in scripts/lib/issue-codes/: family.name.

next.description: The command that fixes or explains the issue, where there is one.
